# DIZZY Onboarding — Agent Overview

# DIZZY Onboarding — Agent Overview

> Printed by `dizzy onboard`. This is the opinionated workflow layer for coding agents
> (Claude Code, OpenCode, pi, ...). Reference pages live under `dizzy docs`:
> `dizzy docs cli` (manpage + roadmap) and `dizzy docs authoring` (the `.feat.yaml`
> authoring guide). Read this first; reach for those when you need detail.

## What DIZZY is

DIZZY is a philosophy/toolchain for event-driven systems. The design lives in one
artifact — the **feature-file** (`.feat.yaml`) — never in an LLM context window.
Every `dizzy` command reads the feature-file; several write to it. If you are an agent
working on a DIZZY project, the feature-file is your map and your contract: change it
deliberately, and regenerate rather than hand-edit generated code.

Two loops drive everything:

```
Commands → Procedures → Events → Policies → Commands   (reactivity loop)
Events → Projections → Models → Queriers → Procedures  (data loop)
```

## The eight components

| Component | Symbol | Role | Naming |
|---|---|---|---|
| Command | `c` | Write intent — a request to do something | imperative snake_case (`ingest_receipt_image`) |
| Procedure | `d` | Handles exactly one command; may call queries; emits events | snake_case verb phrase |
| Event | `e` | Immutable fact — a record of what happened; the source of truth | past-tense snake_case (`receipt_ingested`) |
| Policy | `y` | Reacts to one event; may dispatch new commands | snake_case |
| Projection | `j` | Folds events into a model (read-optimized state) | snake_case |
| Model | `m` | Named read-side schema, served through adapters | plural snake_case (`receipts`) |
| Query | `q` | Typed question — Input/Output contract | snake_case |
| Querier | `Q` | Answers a query from a model via an adapter | snake_case |

Today's feature-file expresses the query/querier pair as a single `queries:` entry —
typed Input/Output plus the callable that answers it.

## The feature-file's role

`.feat.yaml` declares every component, its wiring (which command a procedure handles,
which events it may emit, which model a querier reads), and prose/mermaid descriptions.
It is the API of the entire ecosystem and a versioned, compatibility-guaranteed spec.
A procedure's generated interface declares exactly the command it receives, the queries
it may call, the events it may emit; exceeding declared scope is a type error.

Rules of engagement for agents:

1. Never encode design decisions only in conversation — put them in the feature-file.
2. Never hand-edit generated interfaces (`gen_def`/`gen_int`); regenerate instead.
3. Files you author (`def/` schemas, `libconfig.yaml`, implementation stubs in `lib/`)
   are never clobbered by the generator — they are yours.

## Change taxonomy

Classify every change to the feature-file or its schemas before making it:

- **Additive** — new component, new optional field. Safe; regenerate and move on.
- **Contract-changing** — a slot's type, name, or requiredness changes. Consumers must
  be revisited; the typechecker is your first oracle.
- **Breaking** — stored events no longer parse under the new schema. Needs an upcaster
  or a compat-mode migration (optional-then-drop).
- **Lossy-to-truth** — deletes or stops recording information from the event stream.
  **One-way door.** A field nothing reads today still cannot be naively dropped:
  future projections can never recover it.

The recoverability test: Models are *rebuildable* — replay the event stream through a
projection and you get them back, so model/projection/querier changes are cheap.
Events are *irreducible* — what was never recorded is gone forever. Spend your caution
budget on the event side.

## Exemplar events — good and bad

Good:

- `receipt_ingested { receipt_id, image_path, ingested_at }` — past-tense fact,
  observed data only, carries identity and provenance.
- `recipe_extraction_failed { recipe_id, reason }` — failures are facts too; recording
  them keeps the stream honest.

Bad (and why):

- `ingest_receipt` as an event — imperative; that is a command. Events state what
  *happened*, commands request what *should happen*.
- `average_order_value_updated { avg }` — a derivation recorded as if observed. Derived
  values must be outputs of a procedure with provenance, or live in a model rebuilt by
  a projection — never masquerade as facts.
- `user_registered { email, password_hash }` — PII-class slots in an immutable stream
  you can never delete from. Route sensitive data through commands and models.
- `order_placed` and `order_submitted` sharing most slots — the same fact at two
  grains. Pick one grain per fact.

## Command per lifecycle step

| Step | You want to... | Reach for | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Onboard | Orient yourself / a fresh agent session | `dizzy onboard`, `dizzy docs` | shipped |
| Design | Author the feature-file | `dizzy docs authoring`, then `lint`, `simulate` | docs shipped; rest planned |
| Build | Scaffold schemas, generate types + packages | `dizzy generate definitions` → `static` → `libraries` | shipped (python-uv) |
| Change | Assess a feature-file edit | `diff`, `impact`, `compat` | planned |
| Migrate | Replace a model after a schema change | `rebuild <model>` | planned |
| Run | Observe / compare runtime vs. design | `trace`, `drift` | planned |
| Adopt | Wrap a legacy API as commands/events | `wrap` | planned |
| Deploy | Emit a deployment profile | `deploy` | planned |

The shipped path today (run in order, authoring between each step):

```
dizzy generate definitions <feat_file> <output_dir>   # scaffold def/ + libconfig.yaml — then YOU author field detail
dizzy generate static      <feat_file> <output_dir>   # compile def/ → gen_def + gen_int type packages
dizzy generate libraries   <feat_file> <output_dir>   # per-runtime element packages — then YOU implement the stubs
```

For the full per-command reference and roadmap: `dizzy docs cli`.
For the authoring contract (what you write after each stage): `dizzy docs authoring`.

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>DIZZY LAB — Robot Arm Visualizer</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0b0d14;
    --panel:#12151f;
    --panel2:#161a26;
    --line:#232838;
    --text:#e7eaf3;
    --dim:#8891a7;
    --c-color:#ffb454;   /* command   - amber  */
    --d-color:#5ad1e6;   /* procedure - cyan   */
    --e-color:#ff6fa5;   /* event     - pink   */
    --y-color:#7ee787;   /* policy    - green  */
    --j-color:#6f9bff;   /* projection- blue   */
    --m-color:#3ddc97;   /* model     - teal   */
    --q-color:#c39bff;   /* query/Q   - purple */
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);
    font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;}
  #app{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100vh;min-height:640px;}

  header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:10px 16px;
    background:var(--panel);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);flex-wrap:wrap;}
  header h1{font-size:15px;margin:0;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:700;}
  header h1 span{color:var(--e-color);}
  header .sub{color:var(--dim);font-size:11px;margin-right:auto;}
  .btn{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);
    padding:6px 12px;border-radius:6px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
  .btn:hover{border-color:#3a4256;}
  .btn.active{border-color:var(--y-color);color:var(--y-color);}
  .ctrl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);}
  .ctrl input[type=range]{width:90px;}
  .stat{font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);}
  .stat b{color:var(--text);}

  main{flex:1;display:flex;gap:1px;background:var(--line);min-height:0;}
  #stage{flex:1.15;background:var(--panel);min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
  #graphPane{flex:1;background:var(--panel);min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
  .paneTitle{font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);padding:8px 12px 0;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;}
  svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;}
  #armSvg,#graphSvg{flex:1;min-height:0;}

  footer{background:var(--panel);border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex;gap:1px;background:var(--line);height:190px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .queueCol{flex:1;background:var(--panel);display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;}
  .queueCol h2{font-size:11px;margin:0;padding:8px 12px;color:var(--dim);
    letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;}
  .queueCol h2 b{color:var(--text);font-weight:700;}
  .queueList{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:6px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column-reverse;gap:4px;}
  .qItem{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:5px;
    background:var(--panel2);border-left:3px solid transparent;animation:pop .25s ease;}
  @keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
  .qItem .tag{font-weight:700;width:16px;text-align:center;border-radius:3px;font-size:10px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .qItem .name{color:var(--text);flex-shrink:0;}
  .qItem .meta{color:var(--dim);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .qItem.pending{opacity:.55;border-left-style:dashed;}
  .legendCol{width:250px;background:var(--panel);padding:8px 12px;overflow-y:auto;flex-shrink:0;}
  .legendCol h2{font-size:11px;margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .legRow{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline;font-size:10.5px;padding:2px 0;color:var(--dim);}
  .legRow .sw{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;top:1px;}
  .legRow b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600;}

  /* --- arm scene styling --- */
  .station-label{fill:var(--dim);font-size:10px;text-anchor:middle;}
  .station-pad{fill:#1c2130;stroke:var(--line);stroke-width:1;}
  .station-pad.active{stroke-width:2;}
  .table-line{stroke:var(--line);stroke-width:2;}
  .arm-link{stroke:#5a6478;stroke-width:10;stroke-linecap:round;}
  .arm-link2{stroke:#78839a;stroke-width:8;stroke-linecap:round;}
  .arm-base{fill:#2a3040;stroke:var(--line);}
  .gripper{stroke:#c7cee0;stroke-width:4;stroke-linecap:round;fill:none;}
  .sample{stroke:#000;stroke-opacity:.25;stroke-width:1;}

  /* --- graph styling --- */
  .edge{fill:none;stroke:#2a3042;stroke-width:1.4;}
  .edge.calls{stroke-dasharray:3 3;}
  .node rect{stroke-width:1.4;fill:var(--panel2);}
  .node text{font-size:9.5px;fill:var(--text);}
  .node .badge{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;}
  .node.active rect{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px currentColor);}
  .groupLabel{fill:var(--dim);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .particle{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px currentColor);}

  ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;height:8px;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#2a3042;border-radius:4px;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">
  <header>
    <h1>DIZZY <span>LAB</span></h1>
    <div class="sub">a stylized robot-arm visualization of an event-driven DIZZY system</div>
    <div class="stat">completed: <b id="statCompleted">0</b></div>
    <div class="stat">in flight: <b id="statInFlight">0</b></div>
    <button class="btn active" id="playBtn">⏸ pause</button>
    <button class="btn" id="addBtn">＋ add sample</button>
    <div class="ctrl">speed <input type="range" id="speedRange" min="0.5" max="3" step="0.1" value="1"></div>
    <div class="ctrl"><label><input type="checkbox" id="autoChk" checked> auto-spawn</label></div>
  </header>

  <main>
    <div id="stage">
      <div class="paneTitle">Robot Arm — Sample Pipeline</div>
      <svg id="armSvg" viewBox="0 0 800 420"></svg>
    </div>
    <div id="graphPane">
      <div class="paneTitle">Reactivity &amp; Data Loops</div>
      <svg id="graphSvg" viewBox="0 0 820 570"></svg>
    </div>
  </main>

  <footer>
    <div class="queueCol">
      <h2>Command Queue <b id="cmdCount">0</b></h2>
      <div class="queueList" id="cmdList"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="queueCol">
      <h2>Event Log <b id="evtCount">0</b></h2>
      <div class="queueList" id="evtList"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="legendCol">
      <h2>Component Legend</h2>
      <div class="legRow"><span class="sw" style="background:var(--c-color)"></span><b>c</b> Command — write intent</div>
      <div class="legRow"><span class="sw" style="background:var(--d-color)"></span><b>d</b> Procedure — handles one command</div>
      <div class="legRow"><span class="sw" style="background:var(--e-color)"></span><b>e</b> Event — immutable fact</div>
      <div class="legRow"><span class="sw" style="background:var(--y-color)"></span><b>y</b> Policy — reacts, dispatches</div>
      <div class="legRow"><span class="sw" style="background:var(--j-color)"></span><b>j</b> Projection — folds events</div>
      <div class="legRow"><span class="sw" style="background:var(--m-color)"></span><b>m</b> Model — read-side state</div>
      <div class="legRow"><span class="sw" style="background:var(--q-color)"></span><b>q/Q</b> Query+Querier — typed read</div>
    </div>
  </footer>
</div>

<script>
"use strict";
/* ============================================================
   0. small utils
   ============================================================ */
const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
const $  = (sel,root=document) => root.querySelector(sel);
const el = (tag, attrs={}, ns=NS) => {
  const e = document.createElementNS(ns, tag);
  for (const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
  return e;
};
const clamp = (v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const lerp = (a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
const easeInOutQuad = t => t<0.5 ? 2*t*t : 1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,2)/2;
function angleLerp(a,b,t){
  let d = ((b-a+Math.PI)%(2*Math.PI)+2*Math.PI)%(2*Math.PI) - Math.PI;
  return a + d*t;
}
function speedFactor(){ return Number(speedRange.value)||1; }
function wait(ms){ return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, ms/speedFactor())); }
let uid = 0;
const nextId = ()=>"s"+(++uid);

/* ============================================================
   1. Component graph definition (a mini "feature-file")
   ============================================================ */
const COL = {c:70, d:235, e:400, y:565};
const NODES = [
  // commands
  {id:"c_collect",   type:"c", label:"collect_sample",   x:COL.c, y:70,  desc:"Command — pick a sample from a bin. Imperative snake_case; write intent only."},
  {id:"c_transport",  type:"c", label:"transport_sample", x:COL.c, y:160, desc:"Command — move the held sample to a destination station."},
  {id:"c_process",    type:"c", label:"process_sample",   x:COL.c, y:250, desc:"Command — run the current station's processor on the sample."},
  {id:"c_store",      type:"c", label:"store_sample",     x:COL.c, y:340, desc:"Command — place a finished sample in the output tray."},
  // procedures
  {id:"d_collect",    type:"d", label:"collect_sample_proc",   x:COL.d, y:70,  desc:"Procedure — handles collect_sample. Drives the arm, emits sample_collected."},
  {id:"d_transport",  type:"d", label:"transport_sample_proc", x:COL.d, y:160, desc:"Procedure — handles transport_sample. Drives the arm, emits sample_arrived."},
  {id:"d_process",    type:"d", label:"process_sample_proc",   x:COL.d, y:250, desc:"Procedure — handles process_sample. Calls get_sample_status first, then emits sample_processed."},
  {id:"d_store",      type:"d", label:"store_sample_proc",     x:COL.d, y:340, desc:"Procedure — handles store_sample. Drives the arm, emits sample_stored."},
  // events
  {id:"e_collected",  type:"e", label:"sample_collected", x:COL.e, y:70,  desc:"Event — fact: a sample left its bin. Past-tense, immutable, source of truth."},
  {id:"e_arrived",    type:"e", label:"sample_arrived",   x:COL.e, y:160, desc:"Event — fact: a sample reached a station."},
  {id:"e_processed",  type:"e", label:"sample_processed", x:COL.e, y:250, desc:"Event — fact: a processor finished acting on a sample."},
  {id:"e_stored",     type:"e", label:"sample_stored",    x:COL.e, y:340, desc:"Event — fact: a sample was placed in the output tray."},
  // policies
  {id:"y_route_proc",   type:"y", label:"route_to_processor",     x:COL.y, y:90,  desc:"Policy — reacts to sample_collected; dispatches transport_sample toward the first processor."},
  {id:"y_route_arrival", type:"y", label:"route_on_arrival",       x:COL.y, y:195, desc:"Policy — reacts to sample_arrived; dispatches process_sample or store_sample depending on the station."},
  {id:"y_advance",      type:"y", label:"advance_after_processing", x:COL.y, y:300, desc:"Policy — reacts to sample_processed; dispatches transport_sample to the next stage, or store_sample if finished."},
  // projections
  {id:"j_registry", type:"j", label:"sample_registry_proj", x:340, y:445, desc:"Projection — folds every sample_* event into the samples model."},
  {id:"j_arm",       type:"j", label:"arm_telemetry_proj",   x:340, y:520, desc:"Projection — folds collected/arrived events into the arm_status model."},
  // models
  {id:"m_samples", type:"m", label:"samples",    x:520, y:445, desc:"Model — read-optimized state of every sample and its current stage."},
  {id:"m_arm",     type:"m", label:"arm_status", x:520, y:520, desc:"Model — read-optimized arm position/activity state."},
  // query/querier (dizzy expresses q+Q as one queries: entry)
  {id:"q_status", type:"q", label:"get_sample_status", x:700, y:483, desc:"Query/Querier pair — typed Input/Output answered from the samples model."},
];
const NODE_BY_ID = Object.fromEntries(NODES.map(n=>[n.id,n]));

const EDGES = [
  {from:"c_collect",  to:"d_collect"},
  {from:"c_transport",to:"d_transport"},
  {from:"c_process",  to:"d_process"},
  {from:"c_store",    to:"d_store"},

  {from:"d_collect",  to:"e_collected"},
  {from:"d_transport",to:"e_arrived"},
  {from:"d_process",  to:"e_processed"},
  {from:"d_store",    to:"e_stored"},

  {from:"e_collected", to:"y_route_proc"},
  {from:"e_arrived",   to:"y_route_arrival"},
  {from:"e_processed", to:"y_advance"},

  {from:"y_route_proc",    to:"c_transport", curve:"back"},
  {from:"y_route_arrival", to:"c_process",   curve:"back"},
  {from:"y_route_arrival", to:"c_store",     curve:"back"},
  {from:"y_advance",       to:"c_transport", curve:"back"},
  {from:"y_advance",       to:"c_store",     curve:"back"},

  {from:"e_collected", to:"j_arm"},
  {from:"e_arrived",   to:"j_arm"},
  {from:"e_collected", to:"j_registry"},
  {from:"e_arrived",   to:"j_registry"},
  {from:"e_processed", to:"j_registry"},
  {from:"e_stored",    to:"j_registry"},

  {from:"j_registry", to:"m_samples"},
  {from:"j_arm",       to:"m_arm"},

  {from:"d_process", to:"q_status", kind:"calls"},
  {from:"q_status",  to:"d_process", kind:"answers", curve:"low"},
];

/* ============================================================
   2. Build the graph SVG
   ============================================================ */
const graphSvg = $("#graphSvg");
const typeColorVar = {c:"--c-color",d:"--d-color",e:"--e-color",y:"--y-color",j:"--j-color",m:"--m-color",q:"--q-color"};
const rootStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
const typeColor = t => rootStyle.getPropertyValue(typeColorVar[t]).trim();

function edgePath(a,b,edge){
  const NW=60, NH=20; // half node box approx for anchor trimming
  let x1=a.x, y1=a.y, x2=b.x, y2=b.y;
  if (edge.curve==="back"){
    // loop from a policy back up-and-over to a command, big arc across the top
    const midY = -20;
    return `M ${x1+34} ${y1} C ${x1+120} ${midY}, ${x2+120} ${midY}, ${x2+34} ${y2-10}`;
  }
  if (edge.curve==="low"){
    return `M ${x1-38} ${y1} C ${x1-90} ${y1+40}, ${x2+40} ${y1+40}, ${x2+38} ${y2+2}`;
  }
  // default: gentle horizontal/vertical bezier
  const dx = x2-x1, dy=y2-y1;
  if (Math.abs(dy) < 4){
    return `M ${x1+34} ${y1} C ${x1+ (dx*0.5)} ${y1}, ${x2-(dx*0.5)} ${y2}, ${x2-34} ${y2}`;
  }
  return `M ${x1} ${y1+12} C ${x1} ${y1+ dy*0.5}, ${x2} ${y2 - dy*0.5}, ${x2} ${y2-12}`;
}

const edgeEls = {};
for (const edge of EDGES){
  const a = NODE_BY_ID[edge.from], b = NODE_BY_ID[edge.to];
  const p = el("path",{class:"edge"+(edge.kind==="calls"?" calls":""), d: edgePath(a,b,edge)});
  graphSvg.appendChild(p);
  const key = edge.from+"->"+edge.to+(edge.curve||"");
  edgeEls[key] = {el:p, edge, a, b};
}

function findEdge(from,to){
  for (const k in edgeEls) if (edgeEls[k].edge.from===from && edgeEls[k].edge.to===to) return edgeEls[k];
  return null;
}

// group labels
const groupLabels = [
  {t:"commands",   x:COL.c, y:30},
  {t:"procedures", x:COL.d, y:30},
  {t:"events",     x:COL.e, y:30},
  {t:"policies",   x:COL.y, y:30},
  {t:"projections",x:340,   y:410},
  {t:"models",     x:520,   y:410},
  {t:"query",      x:700,   y:448},
];
for (const g of groupLabels){
  const t = el("text",{class:"groupLabel",x:g.x,y:g.y,"text-anchor":"middle"});
  t.textContent = g.t;
  graphSvg.appendChild(t);
}
// loop captions
const capA = el("text",{class:"groupLabel",x:410,y:565,"text-anchor":"middle"});
capA.textContent = "reactivity loop:  commands → procedures → events → policies → commands";
graphSvg.appendChild(capA);

const tooltip = el("text",{id:"tip",x:10,y:565,"text-anchor":"start"});
tooltip.setAttribute("style","fill:#c9cfe0;font-size:11px;");
graphSvg.insertBefore(tooltip, graphSvg.firstChild);

const nodeEls = {};
for (const n of NODES){
  const g = el("g",{class:"node", transform:`translate(${n.x},${n.y})`, style:`color:${typeColor(n.type)}`});
  const w = Math.max(96, n.label.length*6.1+30);
  const rect = el("rect",{x:-w/2,y:-13,width:w,height:26,rx:7,stroke:typeColor(n.type)});
  const badge = el("text",{class:"badge",x:-w/2+10,y:4,fill:typeColor(n.type)});
  badge.textContent = n.type;
  const label = el("text",{x:-w/2+24,y:4});
  label.textContent = n.label;
  g.appendChild(rect); g.appendChild(badge); g.appendChild(label);
  g.addEventListener("mouseenter", ()=>{ tooltip.textContent = `${n.type} · ${n.label} — ${n.desc}`; });
  g.addEventListener("mouseleave", ()=>{ tooltip.textContent = ""; });
  graphSvg.appendChild(g);
  nodeEls[n.id] = g;
}

function pulseNode(id, ms=520){
  const g = nodeEls[id];
  if (!g) return;
  g.classList.add("active");
  clearTimeout(g._t);
  g._t = setTimeout(()=>g.classList.remove("active"), ms/speedFactor());
}

function pulseEdge(from,to,{reverse=false}={}){
  const rec = findEdge(from,to);
  if (!rec) return Promise.resolve();
  const path = rec.el;
  const len = path.getTotalLength();
  const color = typeColor(rec.a.type);
  const dot = el("circle",{class:"particle", r:4.2, fill:color});
  graphSvg.appendChild(dot);
  const dur = clamp(len*2.2, 260, 900) / speedFactor();
  const t0 = performance.now();
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    function frame(now){
      let t = clamp((now-t0)/dur, 0, 1);
      let d = reverse ? (1-t) : t;
      const pt = path.getPointAtLength(len*d);
      dot.setAttribute("cx", pt.x); dot.setAttribute("cy", pt.y);
      if (t<1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      else { dot.remove(); resolve(); }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  });
}

/* ============================================================
   3. Command / Event bus + queue UI
   ============================================================ */
const cmdList = $("#cmdList"), evtList = $("#evtList");
const cmdCountEl = $("#cmdCount"), evtCountEl = $("#evtCount");
let cmdSeq = 0, evtSeq = 0;
const pending = []; // FIFO of {type,payload,resolve,rowEl}

function shortSample(s){ return s ? s.slice(0,5) : ""; }

function addQueueRow(list, tag, tagColorVar, name, meta, pendingCls){
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "qItem"+(pendingCls?" pending":"");
  row.style.borderLeftColor = `var(${tagColorVar})`;
  row.innerHTML = `<span class="tag" style="background:${`var(${tagColorVar})`}22;color:var(${tagColorVar})">${tag}</span>`+
                   `<span class="name">${name}</span><span class="meta">${meta}</span>`;
  list.appendChild(row);
  while (list.children.length > 60) list.removeChild(list.firstChild);
  return row;
}

function dispatch(type, payload){
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    cmdSeq++;
    const row = addQueueRow(cmdList, "c", "--c-color", NODE_BY_ID[type].label, `#${shortSample(payload.sampleId)} ${payload.note||""}`, true);
    pending.push({type,payload,resolve,row});
    cmdCountEl.textContent = pending.length;
  });
}

function emitEvent(type, payload){
  evtSeq++;
  addQueueRow(evtList, "e", "--e-color", NODE_BY_ID[type].label, `#${shortSample(payload.sampleId)} ${payload.note||""}`);
  evtCountEl.textContent = evtSeq;
}

/* ============================================================
   4. Robot arm scene
   ============================================================ */
const armSvg = $("#armSvg");
const BASE = {x:400,y:390};
const L1=180, L2=160;
const LIFT_Y = 210;
const TABLE_Y = 340;

const STATIONS = {
  bin1:   {x:110, y:TABLE_Y, label:"Bin A", kind:"bin"},
  bin2:   {x:180, y:TABLE_Y, label:"Bin B", kind:"bin"},
  bin3:   {x:250, y:TABLE_Y, label:"Bin C", kind:"bin"},
  heater:   {x:470, y:TABLE_Y, label:"Heater",   kind:"proc", color:"#ff8a3d"},
  analyzer: {x:560, y:TABLE_Y, label:"Analyzer", kind:"proc", color:"#3da5ff"},
  cooler:   {x:650, y:TABLE_Y, label:"Cooler",   kind:"proc", color:"#33d17a"},
  output: {x:740, y:TABLE_Y, label:"Output", kind:"output"},
};
const BINS = ["bin1","bin2","bin3"];
const PROC_ORDER = ["heater","analyzer","cooler"];
const STAGE_COLOR = {raw:"#9aa0a6", heater:"#ff8a3d", analyzer:"#3da5ff", cooler:"#33d17a", done:"#c39bff"};

// table + stations
armSvg.appendChild(el("line",{class:"table-line",x1:40,y1:TABLE_Y+34,x2:780,y2:TABLE_Y+34}));
const stationEls = {};
for (const id in STATIONS){
  const s = STATIONS[id];
  const g = el("g",{transform:`translate(${s.x},${s.y})`});
  const pad = el("rect",{class:"station-pad", x:-26,y:24,width:52,height:14,rx:4,
    stroke: s.color || "#3a4256"});
  g.appendChild(pad);
  if (s.kind==="proc"){
    const ring = el("circle",{r:20, fill:"none", stroke:s.color, "stroke-width":2, "stroke-opacity":.55});
    g.appendChild(ring);
  } else if (s.kind==="bin"){
    const b = el("rect",{x:-16,y:-14,width:32,height:28,rx:3,fill:"#1c2130",stroke:"#3a4256"});
    g.appendChild(b);
  } else if (s.kind==="output"){
    const b = el("rect",{x:-22,y:-10,width:44,height:24,rx:4,fill:"#1c2130",stroke:"#9a7bff"});
    g.appendChild(b);
  }
  const label = el("text",{class:"station-label", x:0, y:56});
  label.textContent = s.label;
  g.appendChild(label);
  armSvg.appendChild(g);
  stationEls[id] = {g, pad};
}

function flashStation(id, ms=650){
  const rec = stationEls[id]; if (!rec) return;
  rec.pad.classList.add("active");
  rec.pad.setAttribute("stroke", "#fff");
  clearTimeout(rec._t);
  rec._t = setTimeout(()=>{ rec.pad.classList.remove("active"); rec.pad.setAttribute("stroke", STATIONS[id].color||"#3a4256"); }, ms/speedFactor());
}

// arm graphics
const armBase = el("circle",{class:"arm-base", cx:BASE.x, cy:BASE.y, r:18});
const link1 = el("line",{class:"arm-link"});
const link2 = el("line",{class:"arm-link2"});
const clawL = el("line",{class:"gripper"});
const clawR = el("line",{class:"gripper"});
armSvg.appendChild(el("rect",{x:BASE.x-30,y:BASE.y+8,width:60,height:14,rx:3,fill:"#20242f"}));
armSvg.appendChild(link1); armSvg.appendChild(link2);
armSvg.appendChild(clawL); armSvg.appendChild(clawR);
armSvg.appendChild(armBase);

function ik(tx,ty){
  let dx=tx-BASE.x, dy=ty-BASE.y;
  let dist = clamp(Math.hypot(dx,dy), Math.abs(L1-L2)+1, L1+L2-1);
  const a1 = Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  const a2 = Math.acos(clamp((L1*L1+dist*dist-L2*L2)/(2*L1*dist),-1,1));
  const shoulder = a1 - a2;
  const theta3 = Math.acos(clamp((L1*L1+L2*L2-dist*dist)/(2*L1*L2),-1,1));
  const elbow = shoulder + (Math.PI - theta3); // world angle of link2
  return {shoulder, elbow};
}

const arm = {
  shoulder:0, elbow:0.6, grip:0,           // current
  tShoulder:0, tElbow:0.6, tGrip:0,        // target
  aShoulder:0, aElbow:0.6, aGrip:0,        // anim start
  start:0, dur:1,
};
{ const s = ik(STATIONS.bin1.x, LIFT_Y); arm.shoulder=arm.tShoulder=arm.aShoulder=s.shoulder;
  arm.elbow=arm.tElbow=arm.aElbow=s.elbow; }

function setArmTarget(x,y,grip,durMs){
  const k = ik(x,y);
  arm.aShoulder = arm.shoulder; arm.aElbow = arm.elbow; arm.aGrip = arm.grip;
  arm.tShoulder = k.shoulder; arm.tElbow = k.elbow; arm.tGrip = grip;
  arm.start = performance.now(); arm.dur = Math.max(120, durMs)/speedFactor();
  return new Promise(res=>{ arm._resolve = res; });
}

let wrist = {x:0,y:0};
function tickArm(now){
  const t = clamp((now-arm.start)/arm.dur, 0, 1);
  const e = easeInOutQuad(t);
  arm.shoulder = angleLerp(arm.aShoulder, arm.tShoulder, e);
  arm.elbow    = angleLerp(arm.aElbow, arm.tElbow, e);
  arm.grip     = lerp(arm.aGrip, arm.tGrip, e);

  const elbowPt = {x:BASE.x+L1*Math.cos(arm.shoulder), y:BASE.y+L1*Math.sin(arm.shoulder)};
  wrist = {x:elbowPt.x+L2*Math.cos(arm.elbow), y:elbowPt.y+L2*Math.sin(arm.elbow)};

  link1.setAttribute("x1",BASE.x); link1.setAttribute("y1",BASE.y);
  link1.setAttribute("x2",elbowPt.x); link1.setAttribute("y2",elbowPt.y);
  link2.setAttribute("x1",elbowPt.x); link2.setAttribute("y1",elbowPt.y);
  link2.setAttribute("x2",wrist.x); link2.setAttribute("y2",wrist.y);

  const dirAng = arm.elbow;
  const openness = lerp(0.55, 0.12, arm.grip);
  const perp = dirAng + Math.PI/2;
  const clawLen = 16;
  const spread = 8*openness*10; // px offset at base of claw
  const baseOffX = Math.cos(perp)*7, baseOffY = Math.sin(perp)*7;
  clawL.setAttribute("x1", wrist.x + baseOffX); clawL.setAttribute("y1", wrist.y + baseOffY);
  clawL.setAttribute("x2", wrist.x + baseOffX + Math.cos(dirAng)*clawLen + Math.cos(perp)*spread*0.4);
  clawL.setAttribute("y2", wrist.y + baseOffY + Math.sin(dirAng)*clawLen + Math.sin(perp)*spread*0.4);
  clawR.setAttribute("x1", wrist.x - baseOffX); clawR.setAttribute("y1", wrist.y - baseOffY);
  clawR.setAttribute("x2", wrist.x - baseOffX + Math.cos(dirAng)*clawLen - Math.cos(perp)*spread*0.4);
  clawR.setAttribute("y2", wrist.y - baseOffY + Math.sin(dirAng)*clawLen - Math.sin(perp)*spread*0.4);

  if (t>=1 && arm._resolve){ const r=arm._resolve; arm._resolve=null; r(); }
}

// physical arm action queue (serializes moves across concurrent samples)
let armBusy = Promise.resolve();
function armSerial(fn){
  const run = armBusy.then(fn);
  armBusy = run.catch(()=>{});
  return run;
}
async function armPickup(stationId, sampleRec){
  return armSerial(async ()=>{
    const s = STATIONS[stationId];
    await setArmTarget(s.x, LIFT_Y, 0, 500);
    await setArmTarget(s.x, s.y-6, 0, 420);
    flashStation(stationId);
    await setArmTarget(s.x, s.y-6, 1, 260);
    sampleRec.held = true;
    await setArmTarget(s.x, LIFT_Y, 1, 420);
  });
}
async function armCarryTo(stationId, sampleRec){
  return armSerial(async ()=>{
    const s = STATIONS[stationId];
    await setArmTarget(s.x, LIFT_Y, 1, 620);
    await setArmTarget(s.x, s.y-6, 1, 420);
    flashStation(stationId);
    sampleRec.held = true;
    sampleRec.x = s.x; sampleRec.y = s.y-6;
  });
}
async function armDropAndRelease(stationId, sampleRec){
  return armSerial(async ()=>{
    const s = STATIONS[stationId];
    await setArmTarget(s.x, s.y-6, 0, 260);
    sampleRec.held = false; sampleRec.x = s.x; sampleRec.y = s.y-6;
    await setArmTarget(s.x, LIFT_Y, 0, 420);
  });
}
async function armIdleAt(stationId, ms, sampleRec){
  // little processing "shake" without physically leaving — nudge the target
  const s = STATIONS[stationId];
  await armSerial(()=>setArmTarget(s.x, s.y-6, 1, ms*0.5));
}

/* ============================================================
   5. Samples
   ============================================================ */
const samples = {}; // id -> {id, x,y, stage, held, gEl, shapeEl}
let completed = 0, inFlight = 0;

function makeSampleVisual(rec){
  const g = el("g");
  const shape = el("circle",{class:"sample", r:8, fill:STAGE_COLOR.raw});
  g.appendChild(shape);
  armSvg.appendChild(g);
  rec.g = g; rec.shape = shape;
}
function updateSampleVisual(rec){
  rec.g.setAttribute("transform",`translate(${rec.held?wrist.x:rec.x},${rec.held?wrist.y+4:rec.y})`);
  rec.shape.setAttribute("fill", STAGE_COLOR[rec.stage]);
  if (rec.stage==="done"){
    rec.shape.setAttribute("r", 6);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   6. Command handler dispatch table (the "procedures")
   ============================================================ */
async function handle_collect(payload){
  const rec = samples[payload.sampleId];
  pulseNode("d_collect");
  await armPickup(payload.location, rec);
  pulseEdge("d_collect","e_collected");
  emitEvent("e_collected", payload);
  pulseNode("e_collected");
  pulseEdge("e_collected","j_arm"); pulseEdge("e_collected","j_registry");
  pulseNode("j_arm"); pulseNode("j_registry");
  pulseEdge("j_arm","m_arm"); pulseEdge("j_registry","m_samples");
  pulseNode("m_arm"); pulseNode("m_samples");
  pulseEdge("e_collected","y_route_proc");
  await wait(180);
  pulseNode("y_route_proc");
  await wait(160);
  const dest = PROC_ORDER[0];
  pulseEdge("y_route_proc","c_transport",{reverse:false});
  dispatch("c_transport", {sampleId:payload.sampleId, destination:dest, note:`→ ${STATIONS[dest].label}`});
}

async function handle_transport(payload){
  const rec = samples[payload.sampleId];
  pulseNode("d_transport");
  await armCarryTo(payload.destination, rec);
  pulseEdge("d_transport","e_arrived");
  emitEvent("e_arrived", payload);
  pulseNode("e_arrived");
  pulseEdge("e_arrived","j_arm"); pulseEdge("e_arrived","j_registry");
  pulseNode("j_arm"); pulseNode("j_registry");
  pulseEdge("j_arm","m_arm"); pulseEdge("j_registry","m_samples");
  pulseNode("m_arm"); pulseNode("m_samples");
  pulseEdge("e_arrived","y_route_arrival");
  await wait(180);
  pulseNode("y_route_arrival");
  await wait(160);
  if (payload.destination === "output"){
    pulseEdge("y_route_arrival","c_store");
    dispatch("c_store", {sampleId:payload.sampleId, note:"→ Output"});
  } else {
    pulseEdge("y_route_arrival","c_process");
    dispatch("c_process", {sampleId:payload.sampleId, station:payload.destination, note:`@ ${STATIONS[payload.destination].label}`});
  }
}

async function handle_process(payload){
  const rec = samples[payload.sampleId];
  pulseNode("d_process");
  // procedure calls the query/querier before acting
  pulseEdge("d_process","q_status");
  await wait(160);
  pulseNode("q_status");
  await wait(140);
  pulseEdge("q_status","d_process",{reverse:false});
  await wait(120);
  await armIdleAt(payload.station, 700, rec);
  rec.stage = payload.station;
  pulseEdge("d_process","e_processed");
  emitEvent("e_processed", payload);
  pulseNode("e_processed");
  pulseEdge("e_processed","j_registry");
  pulseNode("j_registry");
  pulseEdge("j_registry","m_samples");
  pulseNode("m_samples");
  pulseEdge("e_processed","y_advance");
  await wait(180);
  pulseNode("y_advance");
  await wait(160);
  const idx = PROC_ORDER.indexOf(payload.station);
  if (idx < PROC_ORDER.length-1){
    const dest = PROC_ORDER[idx+1];
    pulseEdge("y_advance","c_transport");
    dispatch("c_transport", {sampleId:payload.sampleId, destination:dest, note:`→ ${STATIONS[dest].label}`});
  } else {
    pulseEdge("y_advance","c_store");
    dispatch("c_store", {sampleId:payload.sampleId, note:"→ Output"});
  }
}

async function handle_store(payload){
  const rec = samples[payload.sampleId];
  pulseNode("d_store");
  await armCarryTo("output", rec);
  await armDropAndRelease("output", rec);
  rec.stage = "done";
  pulseEdge("d_store","e_stored");
  emitEvent("e_stored", payload);
  pulseNode("e_stored");
  pulseEdge("e_stored","j_registry");
  pulseNode("j_registry");
  pulseEdge("j_registry","m_samples");
  pulseNode("m_samples");
  completed++; inFlight = Math.max(0,inFlight-1);
  statCompleted.textContent = completed;
  statInFlight.textContent = inFlight;
  setTimeout(()=>{ rec.g.remove(); delete samples[payload.sampleId]; }, 900/speedFactor());
}

const HANDLERS = {c_collect:handle_collect, c_transport:handle_transport, c_process:handle_process, c_store:handle_store};

/* single-consumer command loop: models "procedures execute one command at a time" */
async function commandLoop(){
  while (true){
    if (pending.length === 0){ await wait(90); continue; }
    const item = pending.shift();
    cmdCountEl.textContent = pending.length;
    item.row.classList.remove("pending");
    pulseEdge(item.type, "d_"+item.type.slice(2));
    try { await HANDLERS[item.type](item.payload); } catch(err){ console.error(err); }
    item.resolve();
  }
}
commandLoop();

/* ============================================================
   7. Sample lifecycle (spawns a task per sample)
   ============================================================ */
async function runSample(){
  const id = nextId();
  const location = BINS[Math.floor(Math.random()*BINS.length)];
  const rec = {id, x:STATIONS[location].x, y:STATIONS[location].y-6, stage:"raw", held:false};
  samples[id] = rec;
  makeSampleVisual(rec);
  inFlight++; statInFlight.textContent = inFlight;

  await dispatch("c_collect", {sampleId:id, location, note:`@ ${STATIONS[location].label}`});
  await dispatch("c_transport", {sampleId:id, destination:PROC_ORDER[0], note:`→ ${STATIONS[PROC_ORDER[0]].label}`}).then(()=>{});
}

/* the very first dispatch inside handle_* chains itself, so runSample only
   needs to kick off the collect step — subsequent commands are dispatched by
   the policies. We just fire-and-forget the initial command here. */
async function spawnSample(){
  const id = nextId();
  const location = BINS[Math.floor(Math.random()*BINS.length)];
  const rec = {id, x:STATIONS[location].x, y:STATIONS[location].y-6, stage:"raw", held:false};
  samples[id] = rec;
  makeSampleVisual(rec);
  inFlight++; statInFlight.textContent = inFlight;
  pulseNode("c_collect");
  dispatch("c_collect", {sampleId:id, location, note:`@ ${STATIONS[location].label}`});
}

/* ============================================================
   8. Render loop, controls, auto-spawn
   ============================================================ */
let playing = true;
function frame(now){
  tickArm(now);
  for (const id in samples) updateSampleVisual(samples[id]);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);

const playBtn = $("#playBtn"), addBtn = $("#addBtn"), speedRange = $("#speedRange"), autoChk = $("#autoChk");
const statCompleted = $("#statCompleted"), statInFlight = $("#statInFlight");

playBtn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
  playing = !playing;
  playBtn.textContent = playing ? "⏸ pause" : "▶ play";
  playBtn.classList.toggle("active", playing);
});
addBtn.addEventListener("click", spawnSample);

let autoTimer = null;
function scheduleAuto(){
  clearTimeout(autoTimer);
  if (!playing || !autoChk.checked) { autoTimer = setTimeout(scheduleAuto, 500); return; }
  const gap = (2600 + Math.random()*2200) / speedFactor();
  autoTimer = setTimeout(()=>{ spawnSample(); scheduleAuto(); }, gap);
}
scheduleAuto();

// kick off with two samples already moving
spawnSample();
setTimeout(spawnSample, 900);
</script>
</body>
</html>

/* ============================================================
   3. Command / Event bus + queue UI
   ============================================================ */
const cmdList = $("#cmdList"), evtList = $("#evtList");
const cmdCountEl = $("#cmdCount"), evtCountEl = $("#evtCount");
let cmdSeq = 0, evtSeq = 0;
const pending = []; // FIFO of {type,payload,resolve,rowEl}

function shortSample(s){ return s ? s.slice(0,5) : ""; }

function addQueueRow(list, tag, tagColorVar, name, meta, pendingCls){
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "qItem"+(pendingCls?" pending":"");
  row.style.borderLeftColor = `var(${tagColorVar})`;
  row.innerHTML = `<span class="tag" style="background:${`var(${tagColorVar})`}22;color:var(${tagColorVar})">${tag}</span>`+
                   `<span class="name">${name}</span><span class="meta">${meta}</span>`;
  list.appendChild(row);
  while (list.children.length > 60) list.removeChild(list.firstChild);
  return row;

const url = "http://localhost:9222/json/new?" + encodeURIComponent("http://localhost:8934/index.html");

async function main(){
  const res = await fetch(url, {method:"PUT"});
  const tab = await res.json();
  const ws = new WebSocket(tab.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
  let id = 0;
  const pending = new Map();
  ws.addEventListener("message", (ev)=>{
    const msg = JSON.parse(ev.data);
    if (msg.id && pending.has(msg.id)){ pending.get(msg.id)(msg); pending.delete(msg.id); }
  });
  function send(method, params={}){
    return new Promise(resolve=>{
      const myId = ++id;
      pending.set(myId, resolve);
      ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:myId, method, params}));
    });
  }
  await new Promise(r=> ws.addEventListener("open", r));
  await send("Page.enable");
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,8000)); // let the page run for real 8s
  const shot = await send("Page.captureScreenshot", {format:"png"});
  require("fs").writeFileSync("/home/conrad/website/project-dizzy-viz/sonnet5/.shots/shot_real.png", Buffer.from(shot.result.data,"base64"));
  const evalRes = await send("Runtime.evaluate", {expression: `JSON.stringify({frames:window._frames, pendingLen: pending.length, cmdText: document.getElementById('cmdList').innerText, evtText: document.getElementById('evtList').innerText, completed: document.getElementById('statCompleted').textContent})`});
  console.log(evalRes.result.result.value);
  ws.close();
  process.exit(0);
}
main();

async function handle_process(payload){
  const rec = samples[payload.sampleId];
  pulseNode("d_process");
  // procedure calls the query/querier before acting
  pulseEdge("d_process","q_status");
  await wait(160);
  pulseNode("q_status");
  await wait(140);
  pulseEdge("q_status","d_process",{reverse:false});
  await wait(120);
  await armIdleAt(payload.station, 700, rec);
  rec.stage = payload.station;
  pulseEdge("d_process","e_processed");
  emitEvent("e_processed", payload);
  pulseNode("e_processed");
  pulseEdge("e_processed","j_registry");
  pulseNode("j_registry");
  pulseEdge("j_registry","m_samples");
  pulseNode("m_samples");
  pulseEdge("e_processed","y_advance");
  await wait(180);
  pulseNode("y_advance");
  await wait(160);
  const idx = PROC_ORDER.indexOf(payload.station);
  if (idx < PROC_ORDER.length-1){
    const dest = PROC_ORDER[idx+1];
    pulseEdge("y_advance","c_transport");
    dispatch("c_transport", {sampleId:payload.sampleId, destination:dest, note:`→ ${STATIONS[dest].label}`});
  } else {
    pulseEdge("y_advance","c_store");
    dispatch("c_store", {sampleId:payload.sampleId, note:"→ Output"});

function spawnSample(){
  const id = nextId();
  const location = BINS[Math.floor(Math.random()*BINS.length)];
  const rec = {id, x:STATIONS[location].x, y:STATIONS[location].y-6, stage:"raw", held:false};
  samples[id] = rec;
  makeSampleVisual(rec);
  inFlight++; statInFlight.textContent = inFlight;
  pulseNode("c_collect");
  dispatch("c_collect", {sampleId:id, location, note:`@ ${STATIONS[location].label}`});
}

/* ============================================================
   8. Render loop, controls, auto-spawn
   ============================================================ */
let playing = true;
function frame(now){
  tickArm(now);
  for (const id in samples) updateSampleVisual(samples[id]);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);

playBtn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
  playing = !playing;
  playBtn.textContent = playing ? "⏸ pause" : "▶ play";
  playBtn.classList.toggle("active", playing);
});
addBtn.addEventListener("click", spawnSample);

let autoTimer = null;
function scheduleAuto(){
  clearTimeout(autoTimer);
  if (!playing || !autoChk.checked) { autoTimer = setTimeout(scheduleAuto, 500); return; }
  const gap = (2600 + Math.random()*2200) / speedFactor();
  autoTimer = setTimeout(()=>{ spawnSample(); scheduleAuto(); }, gap);
}
scheduleAuto();

const url = "http://localhost:9222/json/new?" + encodeURIComponent("http://localhost:8934/index.html");

async function main(){
  const res = await fetch(url, {method:"PUT"});
  const tab = await res.json();
  const ws = new WebSocket(tab.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
  let id = 0;
  const pendingMap = new Map();
  ws.addEventListener("message", (ev)=>{
    const msg = JSON.parse(ev.data);
    if (msg.id && pendingMap.has(msg.id)){ pendingMap.get(msg.id)(msg); pendingMap.delete(msg.id); }
  });
  function send(method, params={}){
    return new Promise(resolve=>{
      const myId = ++id;
      pendingMap.set(myId, resolve);
      ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:myId, method, params}));
    });
  }
  await new Promise(r=> ws.addEventListener("open", r));
  await send("Page.enable");
  for (const t of [10000,10000,15000]){
    await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,t));
    const evalRes = await send("Runtime.evaluate", {expression: `JSON.stringify({completed: document.getElementById('statCompleted').textContent, inflight: document.getElementById('statInFlight').textContent, cmdPending: pending.length})`});
    console.log(evalRes.result.result.value);
  }
  const shot = await send("Page.captureScreenshot", {format:"png"});
  require("fs").writeFileSync("/home/conrad/website/project-dizzy-viz/sonnet5/.shots/shot_real3.png", Buffer.from(shot.result.data,"base64"));
  ws.close();
  process.exit(0);
}
main();

Summary

Built /home/conrad/website/project-dizzy-viz/sonnet5/index.html — a standalone, dependency-free visualization of a Dizzy-style event-driven system, framed as a robot arm running a sample-processing pipeline.

Scenario: an arm picks a sample from one of 3 bins, carries it through Heater → Analyzer → Cooler, then places it in an output tray. Every step is driven by a real (if miniature) 8-node command/procedure/event/policy graph, matching Dizzy's dizzy onboard model:

  • 4 commands (collect_sample, transport_sample, process_sample, store_sample) handled 1:1 by 4 procedures, which drive the arm and emit 4 events.
  • 3 policies react to those events and dispatch the next command — closing the reactivity loop (commands → procedures → events → policies → commands).
  • 2 projections fold events into 2 models (samples, arm_status); a combined query/querier node (matching the .feat.yaml convention of expressing q+Q as one entry) is called by process_sample_proc before it acts — the data loop (events → projections → models → queriers → procedures).
  • A live Command Queue and Event Log show messages actually queuing and draining FIFO through a single-consumer loop, and animated particles trace each pulse across the graph in sync with the arm's motion.

The arm itself uses real 2-link analytic IK, not canned keyframes, with eased angle-tweened motion and an open/close gripper.

Bugs I hit and fixed during QA (verified via a headless-Chromium/CDP harness since I have no browser UI):

  • A temporal-dead-zone crash (speedRange used before its const declaration ran) that silently froze the whole simulation — moved control lookups earlier.
  • Loop-back policy→command arcs were clipped by the SVG viewBox — widened it.
  • Auto-spawn outpaced the arm's single-resource throughput, causing an unbounded queue where nothing ever completed — added a max-in-flight cap so the pipeline reaches a steady, satisfying cadence.

Confirmed working end-to-end in real time: events fire, samples change color per processing stage, and completions accumulate steadily.
